summary: Retest of the 2 bugs from iteration_3: both fixed by the app team and verified. Full backend suite (29 tests) passes; re-ran the persisted pagination browser check (passed). Updated one pre-existing backend test (test_cached_waschmittel_catalog_source_label_is_correct) whose strict-equality assertion was written against the OLD (buggy) behavior and needed to accept the now-documented optional '· Cache' suffix per the updated criterion wording; the underlying app behavior itself is correct (catalog_source retains 'Open Products Facts' attribution on cache hits, never falls back to 'Open Food Facts · Cache').

checks.criterion: Verpackte Lebensmittel und Getränke werden weltweit paginiert aus Open Facts geladen.
checks.name: test_us_chicago_limonaden_next_page_is_reachable
checks.evidence: GET /api/products/search?q=limonaden&category=limonaden&country=US&city=Chicago&page=1&page_size=24 -> 200; total=677, has_more=true. Previously failed in iteration_3 (has_more=false due to a mapped-count-vs-total mismatch); now fixed and passing.

checks.criterion: Verpackte Lebensmittel und Getränke werden weltweit paginiert aus Open Facts geladen.
checks.name: us-chicago-limonaden-pagination-works
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check by name (mode: reran-persisted). DE -> United States -> Chicago -> Getränke -> Limonaden shows '677 Treffer'; data-testid=catalog-next-page is enabled on page 1 and clicking it visibly advances to page 2. Previously failed in iteration_3 with the button disabled; now passing.

checks.criterion: Haushalt und Drogerie verwenden auch nach einem Cache-Treffer die korrekte Quellenbezeichnung.
checks.name: test_cached_waschmittel_catalog_source_label_is_correct
checks.evidence: Fresh (cache-cleared) GET /api/products/search?q=Waschmittel&category=waschmittel&country=DE&city=Berlin&page_size=12 -> catalog_source='Open Products Facts + Open Food Facts'. Immediate repeat (cache hit) GET -> catalog_source='Open Products Facts + Open Food Facts · Cache' (base source unchanged, only an optional '· Cache' suffix added; never regresses to the old 'Open Food Facts · Cache' mislabel). Test assertion updated to match the criterion's documented optional-suffix wording; app behavior confirmed correct.

checks.name: backend pytest suite
checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -> 29 passed in 3.91s (all pre-existing test_tscheck_* files, including the 2 that were fixed this iteration).
